_comment: F-077 'Der Altar ruft das End' — lang keys for the End-arrival cinematic (sequence/endarrival/EndArrivalSequence + devtools/dev/DevEndArrivalCommands). All keys are NEW; nothing shipped is overwritten. 'eclipse.caption.*' ride S2CCaptionPayload (omen = whisper, rift/spill = subtitle, arrived = title); 'dev.eclipse.*' are operator feedback + handbook docs. The existing chat broadcast 'announce.eclipse.end.arrival' fires unchanged from EndDiscService.announceCrash at the phase-3 boundary — no new announce key is needed. Merge into assets/eclipse/lang/en_us.json + de_de.json after the parallel wave (lang files are locked).

en_us.eclipse.caption.end_arrival.spill: The altar spits out the End
en_us.dev.eclipse.event.start.endarrival: End arrival cinematic started — the disc materializes at the phase-3 boundary.
en_us.dev.eclipse.event.start.endarrival.fxonl: End arrival cinematic started (FX only — no block is written, no flag is committed).
en_us.dev.eclipse.event.start.endarrival.busy: The End arrival cinematic is already running, or the disc is already built/building (use fxonly to replay the show).
en_us.dev.eclipse.event.stop.endarrival: End arrival cinematic stopped — debris cleared, cameras released.
en_us.dev.eclipse.event.stop.endarrival.idle: No End arrival cinematic is running.
en_us.dev.eclipse.doc.event.start.endarrival: F-077: runs the ~50 s 'the altar summons the End' cinematic. Without arguments this is the REAL day-12 path (the End disc materializes at the phase-3 boundary); 'fxonly' replays the identical show without writing a single block.
en_us.dev.eclipse.doc.event.stop.endarrival: Aborts the running End arrival cinematic: block-display debris is discarded and guided cameras are released. World state already committed (a started disc build) keeps running.

de_de.eclipse.caption.end_arrival.spill: Der Altar spuckt das End aus
de_de.dev.eclipse.event.start.endarrival: End-Ankunfts-Cutscene gestartet — die Disc materialisiert an der Phase-3-Grenze.
de_de.dev.eclipse.event.start.endarrival.fxonl: End-Ankunfts-Cutscene gestartet (nur FX — kein Block wird geschrieben, kein Flag gesetzt).
de_de.dev.eclipse.event.start.endarrival.busy: Die End-Ankunfts-Cutscene läuft bereits, oder die Disc ist schon gebaut/im Bau (fxonly nutzen, um die Show erneut abzuspielen).
de_de.dev.eclipse.event.stop.endarrival: End-Ankunfts-Cutscene gestoppt — Trümmer entfernt, Kameras freigegeben.
de_de.dev.eclipse.doc.event.start.endarrival: F-077: startet die ~50-s-Cutscene 'Der Altar ruft das End'. Ohne Argument ist das der ECHTE Tag-12-Pfad (die End-Disc materialisiert an der Phase-3-Grenze); 'fxonly' spielt dieselbe Show ab, ohne einen einzigen Block zu schreiben.
de_de.dev.eclipse.doc.event.stop.endarrival: Bricht die laufende End-Ankunfts-Cutscene ab: BlockDisplay-Trümmer werden entfernt und geführte Kameras freigegeben. Bereits committeter Weltzustand (ein gestarteter Disc-Bau) läuft weiter.
